name: banksync-mcp
description: Connect AI agents to 15,000+ bank accounts — transactions, balances, investments, and loans.
longDescription: BankSync MCP is a Model Context Protocol server with 28 tools that gives AI agents secure, read-write access to financial data across 15,000+ institutions via Plaid (US/UK/CA) and Basiq (AU/NZ). Query transactions, check balances, track investments and loans, and sync data to Notion, Google Sheets, and Airtable — all through conversation.
capabilities: Query bank transactions with date ranges and incremental sync
Fetch live account balances from 15,000+ institutions
Access investment holdings, trades, and loan details
Create automated data pipelines to Notion, Google Sheets, and Airtable
Manage bank connections, workspaces, and sync jobs
